title: Carlo Consani, 'Double writing' in Minoan Linear A
used_for: HT88 structural interpretation; VIR+KA 20 and six KI-RO one-count entries.
note: Interpretation of the six as absences is scholarly inference, not independently adopted.

title: Alexander Uchitel, HT 94
used_for: HT94b KI-RO 1-list and KU-RO 5; HT94a personnel totals; HT30 comparison.
note: Uchitel glosses KI-RO as deficit; Iteration 13 separates observed structure from that gloss.

title: Standard HT88 transcription / explanatory overview
used_for: Cross-check of HT88 transcription and six-entry KI-RO / KU-RO 6 structure.

title: Brent Davis & Miguel Valério, Names and designations of people in Linear A
used_for: HT117 KI-RO heading family; HT88 and HT1 parallels; explicit caveat that absence is only one possibility.

title: Ruth Palmer, Linear A Commodities: A Comparison of Resources
used_for: Independent domain controls and caution that KI-RO can resemble owing in some contexts but not all.

title: Roland Cash & Evelyne Cash, The HT 123 tablet: Accounting in Linear A
used_for: HT123 arithmetic model and conclusion that KI-RO represents a differential between actual and expected/prior amounts; explicit taxation/allocation symmetry.

title: Orazio Monti, Observations sur Quelques Tablettes en Linéaire A
used_for: Published objection to a fixed 'deficit' gloss: HT123 KI-RO quantities may be positive surpluses.
note: Abstract-level access; enough to establish the existence and exact direction of the published objection.
